text:
Shipped v0.114.20: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v0.114.20
- PropLine +EV: Bet now opens the quick bet slip with the Kelly stake (same as the Vigilant feed); tapping the result still opens the big data view.
- Pull down on that screen runs a PropLine-only sweep on the engine now (the busy spinner stays until it lands).
- Engine (restarting now on it): the per-game cap and same-team-lines rule now count everything the account holds in a game, whoever placed it (your Temple -18.5/-17.5 case). Update the app from the Releases page.
